This Appeal, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

The present appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 04.04.2015 in MVC.No.4058/2014 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal and Addl. Judge,
Court of Small Causes, Mayohall Unit, Bangalore, for seeking enhancement of compensation.

Addl. Judge,
Court of Small Causes, Mayohall Unit, Bangalore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The factum of accident is not in dispute.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
NC: 2023:KHC:21210 4.
In the present case, the claimant is a minor boy of aged 13 years and sustained fracture of mid shaft of right femur and other injuries.

The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.1,91,416/- by following the principle of law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Master Mallikarjun v. Divisional Manager, The National Insurance Co. Ltd.,1.

sentences.text:
Even though, the Tribunal has granted compensation on all the permissible heads, but the fact remains that the claimant being a minor boy and sustained grievous injuries and had suffered discomfort, inconvenience, mental agony in his life, besides losing childhood enjoyment, therefore,
under the head loss of amenities, compensation is to be granted, since the Tribunal has not granted compensation under the said head.
Therefore, additional compensation of Rs.40,000/- is awarded under the head loss of amenities in addition to AIR 2014 SC 736 NC: 2023:KHC:21210 what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
The said compensation shall carry interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization.
6. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.

ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 04.04.2015 in MVC.No.4058/2014 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal and Addl. Judge, Court of Small Causes, Mayohall Unit, Bangalore,
is hereby modified to the extent that the appellant/claimant is entitled to additional compensation of Rs.40,000/- under the head loss of amenities along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.

iv. The appellant/claimant is not entitled for interest for the delay period of 392 days in filing the appeal.
v. Draw award accordingly.
